note: Frozen before test-5 is annotated and before any system runs on it. Committed and pushed first; totals are published whatever they are. Per-record outputs are never read.
background: selection-2 has two declared checks that disagree. On test-3 (Codex-annotated, before the guide's absent-place rule) it held back 22 wrong and 2 correct ready regions but raised precision by only 4.0 points (13% -> 17%): does not work. On test-4 (Claude-annotated, under the absent-place rule) it held back 17 wrong and 7 correct and raised precision by 17.2 points (55% -> 72%): works. Both the annotator and the guide changed between them, and Claude also wrote the systems. test-5 keeps the guide of test-4 and uses an annotator other than Claude.

questions.primary: Under the absent-place rule and with an annotator other than Claude, does selection-2 pass the rule it failed on test-3 and passed on test-4?
secondary: What share of hybrid-1's ready regions are correct under the absent-place rule?
Do most of hybrid-1's wrong ready regions come from choosing another place when the annotated place is in GNIS (test-4's primary question, repeated)?

systems.without_check: hybrid-1 (rules-6 first, llm-x2g2-qwen3.5-4b-q4km where the rules reach no candidate), reviewed + derived extents

inputs.draw: benchmark draw-extra --name test-5 --seed benchmark-5/1 --size 120 --prefix S --shape place_offset --shape-version 2 --repeats 0 --exclude-lock eval/splits-2.lock.json --exclude-lock eval/splits-3.lock.json --exclude-lock eval/splits-4.lock.json --lock-out eval/splits-5.lock.json (EXTRA_VERSION 1)

annotations.annotator: the owner, or Codex run on the owner's side. Not Claude.
annotations.procedure: The annotator fills eval/benchmark/test-5/worksheet.csv from eval/annotation_guide.md at the pinned hash (including the absent-place rule) and the pinned GNIS snapshot, without opening system outputs, other test folders or earlier reports. The first commit of the worksheet after this declaration counts, and its message names the annotator; it must pass the checker with 0 errors, and fixes go in a recorded further commit before any run.
annotations.if_codex: Results are labelled 'Codex-annotated; agreement with the owner 54/60 category, 55/60 GNIS IDs'. That calibration predates the absent-place rule, which is stated with the result. test-5 is added to the code's list of Codex-annotated samples before any run.
annotations.if_claude: An amendment is pushed before any run, and the primary question is reported as not settled by test-5 whatever the totals.

how_it_runs: Outputs go to the locked folder eval/benchmark/test-5/reports/. Standard output goes to log files there. LLM cache off, native llama-server.
Common run options: --sample eval/benchmark/test-5/test-5.json --extents data/reviewed/extents.csv --derived-extents data/extents/derived.csv --out eval/benchmark/test-5/reports.

Without the check: `audit rules`; `audit llm --no-cache`; `audit hybrid --sample eval/benchmark/test-5/test-5.json --out eval/benchmark/test-5/reports --with-derived`; `audit score --sample eval/benchmark/test-5/test-5.json --out eval/benchmark/test-5/reports --worksheet eval/benchmark/test-5/worksheet.csv --with-derived --hybrid <out>/test-5-hybrid-1-extents-derived.json` (audit score takes no extent-store options).
With the check: the same with --selection-2 on rules and llm, and --with-derived --with-selection-2 on hybrid and score (hybrid report test-5-hybrid-1-extents-derived-sel2.json).

Stages: `uv run python scripts/diagnose_regions.py eval/benchmark/test-5/test-5.json eval/benchmark/test-5/worksheet.csv <hybrid report> <score report> eval/benchmark/test-5/diagnosis/dispute-candidates.txt`, without and with the check (counts only).

primary_selection_2.works: Among the regions selection-2 holds back, wrong ones are at least twice the correct ones, AND the share of ready regions that are correct rises by at least 5 percentage points (the test-3 rule, unchanged).
primary_selection_2.does_not_work: Anything else, including no ready regions held back.
primary_selection_2.computed_from: the two hybrid score reports' totals: held back correct = correct ready regions without the check minus with it; held back wrong = wrong ready regions without minus with

secondary_stages.supported: Among hybrid-1's wrong ready regions without the check, the stage 'clause choice (other place chosen)' (annotated place in GNIS) is the largest stage AND covers at least half of them (test-4's rule, unchanged).
secondary_stages.not_supported: Anything else, including no wrong ready regions.
secondary_stages.computed_from: scripts/diagnose_regions.py stage counts for the hybrid report without the check

what_follows.if_works: selection-2 has passed 2 of 3 declared checks, including the one by a non-Claude annotator under the current guide. Proposed: turn it on by default in the next release (a manifest change the owner approves).
what_follows.if_does_not_work: selection-2 has failed 2 of 3 declared checks and stays opt-in, recorded as a failed experiment.

expectation_stated_in_advance.primary: uncertain, leaning works. On test-4 the precision rise (17.2 points) was well above the bar, but the held-back ratio (17 wrong to 7 correct) was close to 2 to 1; that ratio is the part most likely to fail.
expectation_stated_in_advance.precision_without_check: about 50%, plausible range 35-65% (test-4 55% and test-2 58%, both Claude-annotated; a different annotator may judge more regions wrong); reported against this range, not a decision

secondary_reported: ready regions, correct, useful coverage for rules, LLM and hybrid-1, with and without the check
correct proposal candidates for rules, LLM and hybrid-1, and hybrid minus rules (paired bootstrap, sign test)
category counts, and how many rows use the absent-place rule (absent-specific in notes)
stage counts with the check, including how many of each stage selection-2 holds back
caveats: The absent-place rule was adopted after test-3's result was seen.
The systems, the rule's wording, selection-2 and the stage script were written by Claude, on dev data and on the test-3 diagnosis.
test-5 holds only one label shape (place, offset).
One annotator; the stage split depends on that annotator's clause choices and GNIS lookups.
About 60 ready regions are expected, so a few records can move the held-back ratio across 2 to 1.
run_rules: Each run happens once. A technical failure may be rerun under this declaration and is recorded.
Only totals are published, in eval/reports/test-5.{md,json}.
